description: Moderate position: Contested facts with balanced evidence

input.problem_statement: Client charged with assault. Victim claims unprovoked attack. Client claims mutual fight. Two witnesses each side. Physical evidence inconclusive.

procedural_steps: emphasize burden of proof on prosecution
negotiate mutual combat plea or dismissal
prepare for trial but push settlement
evidence_needed: any video or photos of scene
argument_titles: Conflicting witness accounts create reasonable doubt
Prosecution cannot meet burden beyond reasonable doubt

validation_notes: Should generate 3-4 arguments (avg 52-66), recommend settlement (evidence truly balanced), success probability 42-58% (coin flip), emphasize reasonable doubt and burden of proof, realistic about uncertainty.
